item.title: ABS-CBN: 50 year limit applies to franchises, not companies
item.description: ABS-CBN general counsel Mario Bautista has argued that the 50-year cap imposed by the Constitution on franchises refers to the maximum period granted per franchise and not the number of years a company is allowed to operate.

item.title: ADB: Only 0.1% economic growth expected in developing Asia in 2020
item.description: MANILA, June 18- The Asian Development Bank (ADB) forecast a growth of only 0.1% in developing Asia as containment measures against COVID-19 pandemic obstructs economic and business activities in the region on Thursday .

item.title: Australia under cyberattacks from state actor
item.description: Australia's prime minister revealed Friday his country was under a broad cyberattack from a "state-based actor" targeting government, public services and businesses, with suspicions falling on China.

item.title: Face-to-face classes to be studied: Palace
item.description: MANILA – While President Rodrigo Duterte has stood pat in his decision not to allow face-to-face (F2F) classes until a vaccine against coronavirus disease (Covid-19) is developed, Malacañang on Thursday said that the proposal to hold F2F classes could still be studied for areas under the “new normal”.

item.title: Palace alarmed over rising cases of violence vs. women, children
item.description: MANILA – Malacañang on Thursday raised alarm over the reported surge in the cases of violence against women and children since the implementation of community quarantine in March to curb the spread of the coronavirus disease 2019 (Covid-19).

item.title: P11.6-M shabu seized in Bacolod buy-bust
item.description: BACOLOD CITY – Police anti-drug operatives seized an estimated PHP11.605 million worth of suspected shabu from a young couple during a buy-bust inside an apartment at Greenplains Subdivision, Barangay Singcang-Airport here on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: 6 suspects nabbed; P680-K shabu seized in Bulacan
item.description: BALAGTAS, Bulacan – Authorities seized around PHP680,000 worth of suspected illegal drugs and arrested six suspects, including a 16-year-old minor, in a buy-bust in Barangay Wawa here on Wednesday night.

item.title: 5 nabbed, P342-K shabu seized in Zamboanga
item.description: ZAMBOANGA CITY – Police arrested five alleged drug personalities, including a militiaman, and seized a firearm and some PHP342,000 worth of illegal drugs here and in Zamboanga del Sur, an official said Thursday.

item.title: P1.1 million worth of marijuana seized in Pampanga
item.description: The Bureau of Customs (BOC) seized more than 900 grams of marijuana with an estimated market value of P1.1 million at Clark International Airport on Thursday.

item.title: 40,535 OFWs sent back home under "Hatid Probinsya" program
item.description: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said a total of 40,534 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) have benefitted from the “Hatid Probinsya para sa mga OFWs” government program.
